stock.description: Prosper Construction Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its core business revolving around offering marine construction, auxiliary maritime, and general building contracting services. Its comprehensive marine engineering operations include ground treatment (both dredging and non-dredging), land reclamation, pier development, establishing foundations for offshore facilities, and marine transportation. Beyond construction, the company is also involved in the rental, sale, and repair of marine vessels. Established in 2001 and headquartered in North Point, Hong Kong, the firm maintains operations across Hong Kong, Mainland China, Indonesia, Macao, Pakistan, Cambodia, and Vietnam. It operates as a subsidiary of Qingdao West Coast Holdings (Internation) Limited.
